title: Front Cover
content: A seagrass meadow of the endangered species Zostera capensis in southern Africa. The cover image relates to Research Article “Conservation implications of strong population structure despite admixture in an endangered African seagrass” [https://doi.org/10.1002/aqc.70012] by Combrink et al.
